heroSummary: Deer Valley Unified started the 2025–26 school year on Thursday, July 31, 2025, and the last student day was Thursday, May 21, 2026. Fall Break ran September 29–October 3, Winter Break ran December 22 through January 2, and Spring Break ran March 16–20. The calendar also listed selected Friday 90-minute early releases, conference half days, and graduation dates in May.
calendarNotes: The official DVUSD 2025–26 instructional calendar lists 180 student contact days with an even 90/90 semester split. The PDF separates Friday 90-minute early releases from half-day release dates for conferences, semester schedules, and the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: When did DVUSD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Deer Valley Unified started the 2025–26 school year on Thursday, July 31, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student contact days were in the DVUSD 2025–26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The reviewed DVUSD instructional calendar lists 180 student contact days: 90 in the first semester and 90 in the second.

calendarFaqs.q: When was DVUSD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: DVUSD Spring Break ran Monday, March 16, through Friday, March 20, 2026. The calendar also listed Friday, April 3 as a Spring Break Day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later DVUSD revisions.

rows: DVUSD schedules 90-minute early releases on selected Fridays from August through May, with no early-release days during state testing.
K-12 parent-teacher conferences use half-day schedules.
December 18 is a 9-12-only half day; December 19 is a K-12 half day.
Staff development full release; students do not attend school.
K-8 parent-teacher conferences use half-day schedules.
The reviewed calendar lists high school graduation dates and times; families should confirm with their high school.
Last student day; DVUSD marks it as a half-day release.
